items.title: fetchGateReceiptProof must request an authenticated read so the customer API key is sent as Bearer auth
items.context: packages/main/src/core/authority-client.ts: get() only attaches Authorization when authenticated:true; protected /v1/receipts/{id}/proof returns 401 otherwise

happy.desc: fetchGateReceiptProof("/v1/receipts/test-id/proof") with a configured customerApiKey -> fetch sends Authorization: Bearer <key> header; WHY: confirms the authenticated:true flag causes get() to attach the Bearer token on the proof endpoint

fetchGateReceiptProof returns success when server responds 200 with valid proof JSON -> outcome.ok===true and data matches AuthorityGateReceiptProofSchema; WHY: proves the authenticated read does not break the happy-path parse

edge.desc: fetchGateReceiptProof with customerApiKey that has leading/trailing whitespace -> Bearer token is trimmed before sending; WHY: get() trims customerApiKey, whitespace-padded keys from env must not leak raw whitespace into the header

fetchGateReceiptProof when server returns 401 despite correct key -> outcome is http_error with status 401; WHY: ensures transport error taxonomy is preserved for authenticated reads (regression guard against swallowing 401 as success)

adversarial.desc: RED/GREEN: revert the authenticated:true option from the fetchGateReceiptProof call -> the fetch sends NO Authorization header and server returns 401; re-apply fix -> Authorization header is present; WHY: the test must fail without the fix (proves the fix is load-bearing, not a no-op)

fetchGateReceiptProof with customerApiKey=undefined (no key configured) -> returns kind:error, ok:false, message contains customer_api_key_unconfigured_fails_closed, and NO network request is made; WHY: fail-closed behavior: an unauthenticated proof fetch must never reach the server

items.title: loadProof must construct the AuthorityClient with resolved auth for the proofPath fetch
items.context: packages/main/src/handlers/authority-enforce.ts: pass resolveAuthorityClientAuth(process.env) as the 4th AuthorityClient arg

happy.desc: loadProof({proofPath:"/v1/receipts/X/proof", authorityURL:"http://stub"}) with LATTICE_AUTHORITY_CUSTOMER_API_KEY set -> the AuthorityClient constructed inside loadProof sends Authorization: Bearer <key> on the proof GET; WHY: proves resolveAuthorityClientAuth(process.env) is passed as the 4th arg so the client carries auth

edge.desc: loadProof({proofPath:"/v1/receipts/X/proof"}) with LATTICE_AUTHORITY_CUSTOMER_API_KEY unset -> throws/rejects with customer_api_key_unconfigured_fails_closed before any network request; WHY: the 4th-arg fix means the client has an auth object, but with no key it must still fail closed via the get() guard

loadProof({proofPath:"/v1/receipts/X/proof"}) when LATTICE_AUTHORITY_URL is unset -> throws with URL-not-set error before constructing the client; WHY: loadProof pre-check on baseURL must not regress when adding the auth arg

adversarial.desc: RED/GREEN: remove the resolveAuthorityClientAuth(process.env) 4th arg from the AuthorityClient constructor in loadProof -> the proof fetch sends NO Authorization header and gets 401; restore -> sends Bearer header; WHY: proves the fix is necessary (the old 3-arg constructor defaults to empty auth)

Partial-fix scenario: CHK-001 fix applied (authenticated:true) but CHK-002 NOT applied (no auth in loadProof constructor) -> proof fetch still fails 401 because client.auth.customerApiKey is undefined even though get() checks authenticated flag; WHY: the two fixes are jointly necessary -- applying only one is insufficient

items.title: The live receipt-ref gate smoke must send an empty-overlap materialOverlapAudit on the DONE gate request, in both the digest input and the signed decision
items.context: packages/main/src/tasks/authority-live-receipt-ref-gate-smoke.ts: DONE enforce gate requires materialOverlapAudit; use buildNoOverlapMaterialOverlapAuditDefault()

happy.desc: Run live smoke (node packages/main/dist/tasks/authority-live-receipt-ref-gate-smoke.js) against staging with auth env vars set -> smoke prints PASS line; WHY: the DONE gate request now includes materialOverlapAudit so Authority accepts it (previously would reject for missing field)

buildPhaseGateRequest(ctx, DONE) returns a request object containing materialOverlapAudit with actualFileOverlaps:[] -> the field is present in the gate evaluate payload; WHY: verifies the digest-input side includes the audit so gateInputDigest covers it

signedTargetGateRequest(ctx, request) for a DONE request -> the signed decision envelope includes materialOverlapAudit; WHY: the signed decision must match the digest input; omitting it from the signed side would cause a digest mismatch on the Authority server

edge.desc: buildPhaseGateRequest(ctx, TEST) -> materialOverlapAudit is NOT added (only DONE needs it) OR is added harmlessly; WHY: TEST gate requests did not previously require this field; adding it only to DONE avoids breaking TEST

adversarial.desc: gateInputDigest mismatch risk: if materialOverlapAudit is added to buildPhaseGateRequest but NOT to signedTargetGateRequest (or vice versa) -> the Authority server rejects with digest mismatch because the two sides disagree on gate input content; WHY: both functions must be updated in lockstep

RED/GREEN: remove the materialOverlapAudit from the DONE buildPhaseGateRequest -> live smoke fails because Authority rejects the DONE gate request (missing required field or digest mismatch); restore -> smoke passes; WHY: proves the addition is load-bearing

items.title: Add a deterministic regression smoke pinning that the proof fetch is authenticated (Bearer) and fail-closed without a key
items.context: new packages/main/src/tasks/authority-receipt-proof-auth-smoke.ts plus a package.json script; must FAIL without the fix and PASS with it

happy.desc: npm run --prefix packages/main test:authority-receipt-proof-auth -> exits 0 with all assertions passing; WHY: the deterministic regression smoke is the primary verification artifact for this story

With customerApiKey configured: stub fetch captures the outgoing request -> Authorization header is exactly "Bearer <key>"; WHY: pins the positive path -- authenticated proof fetch sends the correct header value

Without customerApiKey: the smoke asserts that client returns fail-closed error AND the stub fetch receives ZERO requests -> no network call is made; WHY: pins the negative path -- missing key must not leak an unauthenticated request

edge.desc: customerApiKey is empty string -> treated as missing, fail-closed with no request sent; WHY: empty-string env vars are a common misconfiguration that must be handled identically to unset
The test uses a stub/mock fetch (not real network) -> test is deterministic and runs without Authority env vars; WHY: regression smoke must be runnable in CI without staging credentials

adversarial.desc: RED/GREEN: revert CHK-001 fix (remove authenticated:true from fetchGateReceiptProof) -> the with-key test case FAILS because no Authorization header is sent despite having a key; restore fix -> test passes; WHY: the test is a regression guard that detects the original bug

RED/GREEN: revert CHK-002 fix (remove auth arg from loadProof constructor) -> any test exercising loadProof path FAILS because client has no auth even when env key is set; restore fix -> test passes; WHY: proves the test covers both halves of the fix

Test asserts request count == 0 when no key (not just absence of header) -> a partial fix that sends an unauthenticated request and gets 401 is caught as a failure; WHY: fail-closed means no request at all, not request-then-fail
